place.source_title: Citizens Bank Building, 2nd Street and Putnam Street

brief: Art Deco bank of 1928 on a brick-paved corner: two tall storeys clad in Bedford limestone with fluted piers between tall arched window bays, metal spandrel panels with floral reliefs, a granite base, and a flat parapet.

facade.notes: the Citizens Bank (Marietta OH, 1928): a limestone bank on a corner with tall arched windows between flat pilasters, Art Deco carved panels at the parapet, flagpoles; a brick street with traffic signals and a decorative lamp post

why.note: the bank takes the best corner: visible, solid, stone
